text: And the LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness ; of Sinai, in the tent of the testimony, on day one of the [[2]month ; [1]second [4]year [3]of the second] of their coming forth from out of the land of Egypt, saying,
Take the sum of all the congregation of the sons of Israel according to ; their kin, and houses of their patrimony, according to the number of their names; every male according to their head count.
From twenty years and up, all ; going forth in the force of Israel, you number them with ; their force -- you and Aaron!
And with you there will be each one; [[2]according to [3]the tribe [4]of each [1]of the rulers], [[2]according to [3]the houses [4]of their patrimony [1]they shall be].
And these are; the names of the men who shall stand with you of the ones of Reuben -- Elizur son of Shedeur.
Of the ones of Simeon- Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai.
Of the ones of Judah -- Nashon son of Amminadab.
Of the ones of Issachar -- Nethaneel son of Zuar.
The ones of Zebulun -- Eliab son of Helon.
Of the sons of Joseph, of the ones of Ephraim -- Elishama son of Ammihud. Of the ones of Manasseh -- Gamaliel son of Pedahzur.
Of the ones of Benjamin -- Abidan son of Gideoni.
Of the ones of Dan -- Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai.
Of the ones of Asher -- Pagiel son of Ocran.
Of the ones of Gad -- Eliasaph son of Reuel.
Of the ones of Naphtali -- Ahira son of Enan.
These are the selected ones of the congregation, rulers of the tribes according to their patrimony; [[2]commanders of thousands [3]in Israel [1]they are].
And [[4]took [1]Moses [2]and [3]Aaron] ; these men, of the ones being called by name.

And all the congregation gathered on day one of the month, of the second year. and they were numbered according to their origins, according to ; their patrimony, according to the number of their names from twenty years old; and up, every male according to their head count.
In which manner the LORD gave orders to Moses, and they were numbered in the wilderness ; of Sinai.

And there were to the sons of Reuben, first-born of Israel, according to their kin, according to their peoples, according to the houses of their patrimony, according to the number of their names, according to their head count, every male from twenty years and up, every one ; going forth in the force,
the numbering of them from out of the tribe of Reuben -- six and forty thousand and five hundred.

To the sons of Simeon, according to their kin, according to their peoples, according to the houses of their patrimony, according to the number of their names, according to their head count, all males from twenty years and up, every one ; going forth in the force,
; their numbering from the tribe of Simeon -- nine and fifty thousand and three hundred.

To the sons of Gad, according to their kin, according to their peoples, according to the houses of their patrimony, according to the number of their names, all males from twenty years and up, every one ; going forth in the force,
; their numbering from out of the tribe of Gad -- five and forty thousand and six hundred and fifty.

To the sons of Judah, according to their kin, according to their peoples, according to the houses of their patrimony, according to the number of their names, all males from twenty years and up, every one ; going forth in the force,
; their numbering from the tribe of Judah -- four and seventy thousand and six hundred.

To the sons of Issachar, according to their kin, according to their peoples, according to the houses of their patrimony, according to the number of their names, all males from twenty years and up, every one ; going forth in the force,
; their numbering from the tribe of Issachar -- four and fifty thousand and four hundred.

To the sons of Zebulun, according to their kin, according to their peoples, according to the houses of their patrimony, according to the number of their names, all males from twenty years and up, every one ; going forth in the force,
; their numbering from the tribe of Zebulun -- seven and fifty thousand and four hundred.

To the sons of Joseph, the sons of Ephraim, according to their kin, according to their peoples, according to the houses of their patrimony, according to the number of their names, all males from twenty years and up, every one ; going forth in the force,
; their numbering from the tribe of Ephraim -- forty thousand and five hundred.

To the sons of Manasseh, according to their kin, according to their peoples, according to the houses of their patrimony, according to the number of their names, all males from twenty years and up, every one ; going forth in the force,
; their numbering from the tribe of Manasseh -- two and thirty thousand and five hundred.

To the sons of Benjamin, according to their kin, according to their peoples, according to the houses of their patrimony, according to the number of their names, all males from twenty years and up, every one ; going forth in the force,
; their numbering from the tribe of Benjamin -- five and thirty thousand and four hundred.

To the sons of Dan, according to their kin, according to their peoples, according to the houses of their patrimony, according to the number of their names, all males from twenty years and up, every one ; going forth in the force,
; their numbering from the tribe of Dan -- two and sixty thousand and seven hundred.

To the sons of Asher, according to their kin, according to their peoples, according to the houses of their patrimony, according to the number of their names, all males from twenty years and up, every one ; going forth in the force,
; their numbering from the tribe of Asher -- one and forty thousand and five hundred.

To the sons of Naphtali, according to their kin, according to their peoples, according to the houses of their patrimony, according to the number of their names, all males from twenty years and up, every one ; going forth in the force,
; their numbering from the tribe of Naphtali -- three and fifty thousand and four hundred.

This is the numbering which Moses numbered, and Aaron, and the rulers of Israel -- twelve men, [[2]man [1]one] according to tribe; [[2]one [3]according to [4]tribe [5]of the houses [6]of their patrimony [1]there was].
And came to pass all the numbering of the sons of Israel with ; their force, from twenty years and up, all the ones going forth to deploy in Israel --
six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
But the Levites from the tribes of their patrimony were not considered together among the sons of Israel.
And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
Know that! [[3]the [4]tribe ; [5]of Levi [1]you shall not [2]consider], and ; their number you shall not take in the midst of the sons of Israel.

And you set the Levites over the tent of the testimony, and over all the items of it, and over all as much as is in it! They shall lift the tent, and all the items for it. And they shall officiate in it, and [[2]round about [3]the [4]tent [1]they shall camp].
And in the lifting away the tent, [[3]shall lower [4]it [1]the [2]Levites]. And in the pitching the tent, they shall raise it up. And the foreigner ; going in it, let him die!
And [[4]shall camp [1]the [2]sons [3]of Israel], every man in ; his own order, and every man according to ; his own governing authority, with their force.

But the Levites -- let them camp opposite round about the tent of the testimony, and there shall not be sin among the sons of Israel. And [[4]shall guard [1]the [2]Levites [3]themselves] the watch of the tent of the testimony.
And [[4]did [1]the [2]sons [3]of Israel] according to all as much as the LORD gave charge to Moses and Aaron -- thus they did.
